about.title: Discover, Cook and Enjoy
about.description: Tasty Recipes helps you discover delicious Syrian and Turkish dishes, traditional meals, appetizers and desserts in one simple place.
about.syrianDescription: Discover traditional Syrian recipes such as Kibbeh, Mahshi, Shish Barak, Molokhia and many other dishes.
about.turkishDescription: Explore popular Turkish recipes such as Mantı, İskender Kebab, Pide, Menemen and more.
about.dessertsDescription: Enjoy traditional desserts including Kunafa, Baklava, Maamoul, Sütlaç and other sweet recipes.
about.ideaParagraph1: Our idea is to create a simple, user-friendly platform where everyone can explore recipes from different cuisines and easily find everything needed to prepare each dish.
about.ideaParagraph2: Each recipe includes useful information such as cooking time, difficulty, servings, ingredients and preparation steps.
about.ideaParagraph3: The website also provides search, filtering, favorites, multiple languages and dark mode for a better experience.
